liner.body_md:
## What listeners single out

- **Dark Star** (3 reviews): Seventeen minutes long; starts slowly, then Jerry raises the intensity midway and the band keeps the momentum; Lively performance; reviewer hears Garcia sounding like he plays a Gibson SG, a classic 1969 tone [3][4][5]
- **Doin' That Rag** (1 review): Named as a stand-out track by this reviewer [9]
- **The Eleven** (1 review): Reviewer calls this Eleven one for the ages, possibly the best ever [5]

## The recordings

- **gd1969-05-30.sbd.miller.87516.sbeok.flac16** (recommended): soundboard; 9 songs; 93 min; rated 4.15/5 by 20 [1]. Said about its sound: Slight hiss, but the mix and sound quality beat many other 1969 files; Reviewer praises the soundboard's mix and recording as wonderful; Recording is excellent apart from some hiss that fades from notice after a minute or two [3][4][9]

## Around the show

- Reviewer says Jerry goes far out in the first solo and the band needs a moment to return [6]
- Springer's Inn site in Portland is now condominiums; the Dead played the venue only twice [7]
- Attendee arrived early for the parking lot, danced hard, and later met the band and girlfriends walking past as leaving [8]
- During the break Jerry invited the helper to the U-Haul and shared nitrous oxide [11]
- Rolling Stone's Michael Lydon described the dance ten miles out of town, starting around 9:30, under a full yellow moon [12]
- A huge traffic jam a mile away led people to leave cars in a ditch and walk [12]
- Stands among the best of 1969; likely overshadowed by the June run right after it [5]
- Lydon notes the band's previous Portland gig was at a ballroom with a spring floor that hampered dancing [12]
- Reviewer rates it as fantastic as the Seminole Indian Village shows in Florida a week earlier, arguably better [13]

## Tapers and lineage

- **gd1969-05-30.sbd.miller.87516.sbeok.flac16**: transferred by Charlie Miller; source: SBD -> Cassette Master (Ampex C-90) -> Dat (48k) D [1]. Also: Tape flip in Cosmic Charlie, a short digital noise spot in Doin' That Rag, and Morning Dew has minor tape problems; Missing first few seconds of Me And My Uncle; Turn On Your Lovelight is cut [1]

## Art and photos

- Poster by Gary Ewing: [Grateful Dead Springer's Ballroom U. of Oregon 1969 Concert Handbill](https://concertposterauction.com/Listing/Details/864682/Grateful-Dead-Springers-Ballroom-U-of-Oregon-1969-Concert-Handbill) [15]
